features.name: Druid Starting Proficiencies
features.description:
As a druid, you gain the following proficiencies:

**Armor:** Light armor, medium armor, shields (druids will not wear armor or use shields made of metal)
**Weapons:** Clubs, daggers, darts, javelins, maces, quarterstaffs, scimitars, sickles, slings, spears
**Tools:** Herbalism kit
**Saving Throws:** Intelligence, Wisdom
**Skills:** Choose two from Arcana, Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Religion, and Survival

choices.name: First Skill
choices.description: Choose one from Arcana, Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Religion, or Survival.

choices.name: Second Skill
choices.description: Choose another from Arcana, Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Religion, or Survival.

features.name: Druidic
features.description: You know Druidic, the secret language of druids. You can speak the language and use it to leave hidden messages. You and others who know this language automatically spot such a message. Others spot the message's presence with a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check but can't decipher it without magic.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
Drawing on the divine essence of nature itself, you can cast spells to shape that essence to your will. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for your druid spells.

**Spell save DC** = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier
**Spell attack modifier** = your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier

You prepare a number of druid spells equal to your Wisdom modifier + your druid level (minimum 1). You can change your prepared spells after a long rest. You can cast prepared druid spells with the ritual tag as rituals. You can use a druidic focus as a spellcasting focus.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.description:
Starting at 2nd level, you can use your action to magically assume the shape of a beast that you have seen before. You can use this feature twice. You regain expended uses when you finish a short or long rest.

Your druid level determines the beasts you can transform into:

- 2nd level: Max CR 1/4, no flying or swimming speed (e.g., Wolf)
- 4th level: Max CR 1/2, no flying speed (e.g., Crocodile)
- 8th level: Max CR 1 (e.g., Giant Eagle)

You can stay in a beast shape for a number of hours equal to half your druid level (rounded down). You revert automatically if you fall unconscious, drop to 0 HP, or die. While transformed, your game statistics are replaced by the beast's, though you retain your alignment, personality, and INT/WIS/CHA scores. You can't cast spells while transformed.

payload.name: Wild Shape
payload.description: Transform into a beast you have seen. Max CR and speed limits scale with druid level. Duration: half druid level in hours.

features.name: Druid Circle
features.description: At 2nd level, you choose to identify with a circle of druids such as the Circle of the Land. Your choice grants you features at 2nd level and again at 6th, 10th, and 14th level.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement (Level 4)
features.description: You can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

choices.name: Ability Score Improvement
choices.description: Increase one ability score by 2 or two by 1 (max 20).

features.name: Timeless Body
features.description: Starting at 18th level, the primal magic that you wield causes you to age more slowly. For every 10 years that pass, your body ages only 1 year.

features.name: Beast Spells
features.description: Beginning at 18th level, you can cast many of your druid spells in any shape you assume using Wild Shape. You can perform the somatic and verbal components of a druid spell while in a beast shape, but you aren't able to provide material components.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement (Level 19)
features.description: You can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.

choices.name: Ability Score Improvement
choices.description: Increase one ability score by 2 or two by 1 (max 20).

features.name: Archdruid
features.description:
At 20th level, you can use your Wild Shape an unlimited number of times.

Additionally, you can ignore the verbal and somatic components of your druid spells, as well as any material components that lack a cost and aren't consumed by a spell. You gain this benefit in both your normal shape and your beast shape from Wild Shape.
